source_title: Pinecone Dedicated Read Nodes: Now Generally Available
claim_summary: Dedicated Read Nodes (provisioned read replicas/shards with fixed hourly per-node pricing) declared GA for Standard and Enterprise; companion post adds per-query performance-vs-recall control, metrics export and early-access multi-namespace support
feature: provisioned read capacity; recall/latency trade-off per query
availability: GA on Standard and Enterprise per changelog 2026-04-15
limitation: Vendor claims 77-97% cost reduction on production workloads are unaudited; recall trade-off not independently measured; plan-gated

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: General availability: Fetch by metadata (2026-04-28)
claim_summary: Fetch by metadata filter (without record IDs) declared GA with paginationToken for result sets above 10,000 records per response
limitation: Changelog entry only; behaviour not exercised; the changelog page is mutable and undated per edit

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: New AWS regions for serverless indexes (2026-05-01)
claim_summary: Serverless indexes available in AWS eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) on Standard and Enterprise plans
limitation: Date conflict: changelog 2026-05-01; Singapore press release datePublished 2026-05-04T21:00Z (dateline May 5); Frankfurt press release 2026-05-05T03:00Z; Nexus launch post lists regions under May 8

source_title: Pinecone Nexus: The Knowledge Engine for Agents
claim_summary: CEO and founder announce Nexus, a knowledge engine with a context compiler and composable retriever, and KnowQL, a declarative agent query language with six primitives (intent, filter, provenance, output shape, confidence, budget); early access opened by application
feature: agent knowledge layer; declarative agent query language
limitation: Vendor claims (85% of agent effort on retrieval; >90% task completion; 30x faster; up to 90% fewer tokens) have no published task set or denominator in this post; partner quotes are endorsements not evaluations

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: New Builder plan (2026-05-04)
claim_summary: New flat $20/month Builder plan with blocked (not billed) overages: 10 serverless indexes, 10 GB storage, Prometheus/Datadog monitoring; extended to all GA regions on 2026-06-03
availability: available per changelog; blog post dated 2026-05-06
limitation: Figure conflict: changelog states 100 namespaces per index, Builder blog post states 1,000 namespaces per index; not resolved

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Public preview: Full-text search (2026-05-04)
claim_summary: Full-text search public preview on API 2026-01.alpha: typed document model with BM25 text fields, dense and sparse vector fields, Lucene query_string syntax and $match_phrase filter
feature: hybrid lexical plus vector retrieval in one index
limitation: Status conflict: the 2026-05-04 Nexus launch post lists 'May 7: Full-Text Search is now generally available' while the changelog and the 2026-05-07 blog call it public preview; GA came 2026-09-02

source_title: Release v9.0.0
claim_summary: Total rewrite of the Python SDK: single pip install with gRPC as a Rust extension, three runtime dependencies (httpx, msgspec, orjson) instead of up to 14, mypy --strict clean, Python 3.10+ required, v8 method names kept as aliases; notes say an automated optimization loop swept hot paths
limitation: Vendor benchmarks (3.3x upserts, up to ~17x throughput, cold start ~210ms to ~45ms) are self-measured and called directional; nature of the 'automated optimization loop' not specified

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Public preview: Pinecone Marketplace (2026-05-05)
claim_summary: Marketplace public preview: templates, connectors, Knowledge Agent Toolkit, multi-domain routing, evaluations, versioning/rollback; launch post claims more than 90 knowledge applications
limitation: Reached end of life 2026-08-31 (separate row); application count is a vendor claim

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Cheaper bulk imports and free import credit (2026-06-01)
claim_summary: Bulk-import overage rate cut from $1/GB to $0.25/GB; one-time $250 (1 TB) import credit for Standard and Enterprise
limitation: The 2026-06-01 entry says the credit was 'valid through July 31, 2026', whereas the 2026-09-01 entry says credits expire 60 days after grant with last balances expiring by 2026-11-01; the credit was withdrawn for new subscriptions on 2026-09-01; the $0.25/GB rate is unchanged; price is not energy or lifecycle cost

source_title: The Real Cost of Vector Storage: S3 Vectors vs OpenSearch vs pgvector vs Pinecone
claim_summary: Independent cost model and small latency run: Pinecone Standard cheapest between roughly 300k and 4M queries/month in the author's scenarios; warm p50 61ms with one 672ms p99 outlier in 200 samples on the free Starter tier at 50K x 1024-dim vectors
limitation: Single author, single region, 50K vectors, Starter shared tier; latency includes non-AWS round trip; pricing as of 2026-05-28; no relevance/recall measurement

source_title: Pinecone Nexus integration with Microsoft OneLake (press release)
claim_summary: Announced at Microsoft Build: Nexus connects directly to Microsoft OneLake and builds permission-scoped task artifacts queried through KnowQL
availability: announced; Nexus itself was early access at the time
limitation: Claim drift: this release cites 95%+ token reduction while the May 4 post says up to 90% and the Aug 6 release says more than 90%; Microsoft-side documentation not read

source_title: Full Observability for Pinecone: Introducing an Open-Source Monitoring Stack for SaaS and BYOC
claim_summary: Vendor publishes pinecone-field/pinecone-monitoring, a Docker Compose Prometheus/Grafana stack that scrapes the Pinecone Metrics API for SaaS and BYOC deployments
limitation: Described as open source, but GitHub API reports no detected license and the repository root has no LICENSE file (2026-10-16), so reuse rights are unclear; GitHub API gives repository creation 2026-03-26 (pre-window), so the in-window event is the 2026-06-09 announcement, not the repository's first publication

source_title: Release v8.0.0
claim_summary: Node SDK v8 targets API 2026-04; breaking change makes Assistant uploadFile/deleteFile return an operation to poll (follows the 2026-04-21 API change to asynchronous file operations)
limitation: Breaking change imposes migration work on reusers; not executed

claim_summary: First stable CLI release: bulk import commands, key-based config, confirmation prompts on destructive deletes (with --skip-confirmation), and several breaking command/flag renames; notes say interactive auth flows are kept to support agentic workflows
limitation: Breaking renames shipped without aliases for backup/restore/collection; not executed

source_title: Some initial queries to infrequently read namespaces incorrectly returning empty results
claim_summary: Status page reports a correctness incident: some initial queries to infrequently read namespaces incorrectly returned empty results across AWS, Azure and GCP regions; posted Jun 18 10:00 and resolved Jun 18 18:23 UTC
limitation: No postmortem found; the statuspage API timestamps both updates 2026-06-22T15:29-15:30Z, suggesting retroactive posting; impact size unknown; 18 other in-window incidents are listed in the report, not ledgered

source_title: Pinecone Nexus Is Now in Public Preview
claim_summary: Nexus opened to public preview via request-access Preview Playground or BYOC deployment; connectors live: local upload, Box, Microsoft OneLake; Manifest-driven curation run as sandboxed tasks; customer-run benchmark reports F1 95% on 20 questions
limitation: Customer benchmark n=20 questions (vendor states Q2 ran it without Pinecone in the loop; not independently confirmed); other benchmarks vendor-run; Google Drive, Slack, GitHub, Notion, Confluence and S3 connectors stated as 'close behind', not shipped

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Cohere Rerank 4.0 Fast is generally available, and cohere-rerank-3.5 is deprecated (2026-07-01)
claim_summary: cohere-rerank-4-fast GA; cohere-rerank-3.5 requests auto-served by 4-fast from 2026-08-31; scores differ (thresholds need re-tuning) and large requests can bill multiple rerank units at the unchanged $2.00 per 1,000 units
limitation: Silent model substitution changes relevance scores and billing for unchanged code; notes say requests may be processed outside the United States

source_title: Pinecone releases Nexus into public preview to bring business knowledge to AI agents
claim_summary: SiliconANGLE (Kyt Dotson) reports the Nexus public preview, its connectors and Manifest-based curation, and repeats the vendor-reported 95% accuracy result from customer Q2
limitation: Relies on vendor materials; no independent test; same event as 075-016

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Expanded role-based access controls (RBAC) (2026-07-13)
claim_summary: Expanded org/project roles including granular control-plane and data-plane editor/viewer roles assignable to users, service accounts and API keys; User role renamed Manager; SAML role mapping and SCIM provisioning followed 2026-07-20 (Enterprise); Go SDK v6.0.0 (2026-07-21) added Admin API RBAC clients
feature: least-privilege roles for service accounts and API keys
availability: available per changelog; SAML/SCIM Enterprise only
limitation: Role enforcement not tested; renames affect existing automation scripts

source_title: Nexus GA: It's the Knowledge, Not the Models
claim_summary: Nexus GA for deployment in customer cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) with customer-chosen models and downloadable knowledge archive; vendor reports on one 97-task tau-Knowledge domain that GPT-5.2 with Nexus cut cost per task from $1.45 to $0.53 and halved tool/model calls; own support agent resolution 24.6% to 55.1% after deployment on Jul 17
limitation: Vendor-run benchmark as of Aug 4 on one domain; a fork of sierra-research/tau2-bench exists under pinecone-io (MIT, created 2026-08-01) but the Nexus harness was not found or run; support-queue before/after has no control

source_title: General Availability of Pinecone Nexus Proves Knowledge Drives Real Outcomes for Agentic AI
claim_summary: Press release claims an agent with Nexus solved 47.4% of tau-Knowledge tasks (called 'the top score on the benchmark') vs 46.4% for GPT-5.5 alone (best frontier model on the current leaderboard) at 74% less cost per task; cites an IDC analyst calling the approach promising
limitation: Figure conflict: blog says 77% less cost for GPT-5.5 while the press release says 74%; the 1-point gap is about one task on a 97-task domain; leaderboard placement not independently checked

source_title: KnowQL Working Draft Version 0.1.0
claim_summary: KnowQL 0.1.0 working draft published under the Open Web Foundation Agreement 1.0, defining query documents, sessions and response contracts without mandating a retrieval algorithm
limitation: Spec says it is developed on GitHub at pinecone-io/knowql-spec, but that repository returned HTTP 404 to both gh api and an anonymous request on 2026-10-16; no second implementation found

source_title: Release v0.3.0
claim_summary: Pinecone MCP server release with several npm-audit security fixes (high/critical CVEs, a ReDoS advisory), a security audit moved to the release gate, agent-consumability changes to tool schemas and a live integration smoke test
limitation: Advisory IDs not enumerated in the notes; fixes not verified

source_title: cultivar v0.3.0
claim_summary: Earliest GitHub release of cultivar, an MIT CLI to test agent skills and docs against tasks across coding agents in sandboxes with graders and traces; later releases to v0.5.2 (2026-10-09)
limitation: README lists an Anthropic API key as a prerequisite (grader runs locally) and recommends a third-party sandbox account for remote runs; self-authored tasks risk self-evaluation; not executed

source_title: Designing Agent-Friendly APIs
claim_summary: Vendor publishes six agent-facing API principles (actionable errors with RFC 9457 codes, bounded responses, idempotency, dry-run and confirmation guardrails) and metrics including turns-to-first-successful-call, run as CI evaluations; reports a 3-trial smoke test where SDK TypeErrors cost agents more turns than raw REST
feature: agent-oriented API design and evaluation metrics
limitation: Vendor itself calls three runs of one model a smoke test, not science; CI evaluation claim not observable

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: General availability: Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) (2026-08-25)
claim_summary: BYOC GA on the Enterprise plan across AWS, GCP and Azure: data plane runs in the customer account and an in-cluster agent pulls operations so Pinecone needs no inbound access
limitation: Date conflict: changelog GA 2026-08-25, GA blog post 2026-09-23; isolation claims not audited

source_title: One Year In, and Just Getting Started
claim_summary: CEO Ash Ashutosh marks one year in role and states founder Edo Liberty is stepping back from day-to-day responsibilities while remaining a shareholder and board member; cites unaudited metrics (retention above 130%, annual commitments about 40% of revenue)
limitation: Unaudited financial claims; lists Marketplace as part of the platform five days before its 2026-08-31 end of life

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: End of life: Pinecone Marketplace (2026-08-31)
claim_summary: Marketplace reached end of life and is no longer available, under four months after its 2026-05-05 public preview; users pointed to Pinecone Assistant
limitation: No reason stated; Aug 6 press release and Aug 26 CEO post still presented Marketplace as part of the platform

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Egress metering and monthly egress allowances (2026-09-01)
claim_summary: Egress on reads returning record data is metered with monthly allowances (1 GB Starter, 10 GB Builder, 100 GB Standard/Enterprise); overage billed on paid plans, while Starter and Builder reads returning data are blocked until the next period
limitation: Hard read blocking on lower plans can break small reusable demos; same day the bulk-import credit was withdrawn for new subscriptions

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: General availability: Full-text search and the Documents API (2026-09-02)
claim_summary: Full-text search GA on API 2026-07 via the Documents API: schema-based indexes combining BM25, dense and sparse fields; fetch/update/delete by metadata filter; on 2026-07 POST /indexes becomes schema-only (REST breaking change)
availability: GA on API 2026-07; fuzzy and n-gram matching were added in preview 2026-07-21
limitation: Date conflict: changelog GA 2026-09-02, GA blog post 2026-09-09; GA blog says 'after months of private preview' though a public preview ran from May; no independent relevance benchmark

source_title: Release v10.0.0
claim_summary: Python SDK v10 targets API 2026-07, moves document indexes and SchemaBuilder out of pinecone.preview, and lists breaking changes (preview namespace removed, client-side validation errors outside ApiError, partial-failure semantics for bulk upserts)
limitation: Second Python major version in four months; migration cost not measured

source_title: Release v9.0.0
claim_summary: Node SDK v9 targets API 2026-07 with Documents API and backup schedules; requires Node.js 22+, removes pc.preview, rejects pod-based index creation; Go SDK v7.0.0 followed on 2026-09-28 with a new module path
limitation: v8 line continues on API 2026-04; breaking type changes; not executed

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: Gemini 2.5 Pro and o4-mini deprecations for Assistant (2026-09-15)
claim_summary: Assistant automatically routes requests naming gemini-2.5-pro to Gemini 3.5 Flash and o4-mini to GPT-5 at the same price; Gemini 3.5 Flash added the same day
limitation: Requests keep the old model name but run on another model, so logged model identity no longer reflects execution

source_title: VQ-bench: a Composable Vector Quantization Framework
claim_summary: Pinecone releases VQ-bench, a composable framework and public running benchmark for vector quantizers built from shared primitives, with a paper presented at VecDB@VLDB 2026
limitation: Vendor-maintained benchmark of methods relevant to its own product; paper and leaderboard not read in full

source_title: Pinecone 2026 changelog: End of life: Pinecone Local (2026-10-07)
claim_summary: Pinecone Local, the in-memory Docker emulator for development and testing, reached end of life and its docs were removed; users told to use a separate account project or mock the API
limitation: Removes an offline test path; online test projects now consume metered quotas; no stated reason

claim_summary: Terraform provider v5 adopts go-pinecone v7 and API 2026-07 with schema-style document indexes; some v4 configurations are now rejected at plan time and schema changes replace the index
limitation: Published on the final window day; v4.0.0 (2026-08-01) not ledgered separately; not executed
